notes:
- GIF search no longer shows stale results or a stuck spinner when the query changes, and retries/rerolls clear old errors cleanly.
- Messages paging and thread loading are safer: late page responses cannot overwrite newer inbox state, first replies no longer split a conversation into duplicate top-level messages, and replies posted during a thread refresh no longer vanish.
- Social, Activity and profile tabs recover when a profile id arrives late instead of staying on a loading placeholder forever.
- Dashboard shortcut previews and comment-thread updates handle transient loading states correctly, including cached previews, unseen-comment counts, closed-sheet posts and delete window accounting.
- Overview/profile loading avoids stale lazy-list races and manga library loading now clears stuck states on early exits and retries.
- Better Posters and cover images are more reliable: poster/gallery lookups stay scoped to the correct media, schedule and viewer sources no longer mix up or load blank/broken images, and blank image URLs now fall back cleanly in posters, backdrops, avatars and banners.

Build 682.
